item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 20 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 20 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 19 August 2026(Wednesday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales(Castillejos, Subic, Olongapo, San Antonio), Cavite(Ternate, Maragondon, Alfonso, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes) and Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan, Balayan, Tuy).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, San Felipe, San Narciso, Candelaria, Santa Cruz), Tarlac(Mayantoc, San Jose, Capas, Bamban, Concepcion, Tarlac City, Santa Ignacia, San Clemente, Camiling, Gerona, La Paz), Pampanga(Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Apalit, Arayat, Bacolor, San Fernando, Macabebe, Magalang, Masantol, Minalin, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat, Guagua, Porac, Santa Rita, Mexico), Cavite(Amadeo, General Trias, Indang, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Trece Martires, Bacoor, Carmona, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Naic, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza), Batangas(Ibaan, Batangas City, Lipa, Santo Tomas, Tanauan, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Talisay, Balete, Laurel, Agoncillo, Lemery, Calaca, Taal, San Nicolas, Santa Teresita, Alitagtag, Cuenca, San Jose, San Pascual, Bauan, San Luis, Mabini, Tingloy) and Bulacan(Hagonoy, Calumpit, Paombong).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Rizal, Nueva Ecija(Gabaldon, General Tinio, Bongabon, Laur, Rizal, Cabiao, Gapan, San Antonio, San Isidro, Aliaga, Cabanatuan, Cuyapo, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Jaen, Licab, Llanera, Nampicuan, Palayan, Penaranda, Quezon, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug, Zaragoza), Batangas(San Juan, Rosario, Padre Garcia, Taysan, Lobo), Quezon(General Nakar), Tarlac(Anao, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada), Pampanga(Candaba) and Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Guiguinto, Marilao, Norzagaray, Obando, Pandi, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija(Carranglan, Lupao, Pantabangan, San Jose), Quezon(Infanta, Real) and Laguna(Binan, San Pedro, Santa Rosa, Cabuyao, Calamba, Los Banos, Bay, Calauan, Alaminos) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
